headings.description: Elegant, high-contrast serif font to establish a sophisticated, authoritative tone.

body_ui.description: Clean sans-serif with wide tracking (uppercase) for a modern, luxury feel for subheadings and UI.

visual_enhancers.asset_treatment: Background imagery must utilize grayscale and subtle sepia overlays with mix-blend-multiply to seamlessly integrate into the dark espresso/plum canvas. Avoid pure opacity drops; use CSS blend modes.
visual_enhancers.borders_and_surfaces: Use 1px subtle borders (e.g., border-white/10). Avoid generic glassmorphism unless heavily saturated with dark tones (bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows rather than harsh drop shadows. Use inner glows to give depth to cards.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-24, py-32 for sections. Overlapping bento layouts or editorial 'Swiss Brutalism' mixed with classic editorial.
layouts.navigation: Streamlined Navigation: Home | Our Why | Care Map | Gatherings | Stories | Get Involved | Give. Must include the SheWorriers logo. Background should be solid or highly blurred dark tone, not fully transparent.
layouts.footer: Expanded footer containing legal constraints (501(c)(3), privacy, terms, annual reports). Must also house the Interactive Prayer/Reflection Engine.
layouts.care_map: Action-oriented directory. Categories: Purpose & Provision, Mind & Wellness, Faith & Flourishing, Girls & Teens, Housing & Shelter.
layouts.immediate_help: Highly visible, permanent 'Immediate Help' banner (988/911) routing to crisis pathways. Should use Accent Emerald to signal safety/medical, sticky or fixed positioned.
layouts.our_why: Four impact pillars: Connect, Equip, Restore, Flourish. Use large serif numbers and spacious column grids.

motion.hero_parallax: Subtle, multi-layered parallax scroll effect on the homepage hero section. Background image, editorial decorative blocks, and text move at slightly different speeds.
motion.scroll_reveal: Cards, pillars, and typography fade in and drift upward softly as they enter the viewport. Use framer-motion.
motion.prayer_engine: Private, daily reflection component in global footer. Users submit prayer request/worry. Form utilizes a serene, timed animation where the text softly blurs and dissolves into a comforting confirmation message.

image_urls.description: Black and brown abstract painting, to be used with multiply blend mode.
Grayscale rock formation for grounding texture, applied with sepia overlay.
Woman in community gathering, warm light.
People holding lit candles in darkness. Very grounding and emotional.

components.care_map_card: Uses soft borders, internal padding (p-8), hover to slightly lift. Iconography paired with uppercase Manrope.
components.prayer_form: Minimal inputs. On submit, state changes to true, triggering framer-motion blur (filter: blur(10px)) and opacity 0 on form, swapping to confirmation message.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an editorial, premium landing page for a nonprofit.
Use ONLY raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout structures; avoid Shadcn Card wrappers if they restrict overlapping design.
Apply Framer Motion for scroll reveals, parallax hero, and the blur-dissolve on the prayer form.
Images MUST have grayscale + sepia mix-blend-multiply CSS to tint them to the espresso/plum canvas. e.g., mix-blend-multiply grayscale sepia-[.3] over a dark background.
Never use purely transparent headers; use an espresso or plum solid/blur fill so the cream text remains readable.
Add wide tracking to uppercase UI text (tracking-widest uppercase).
Ensure 'Immediate Help' banner is highly visible, maybe fixed top or sticky, using the emerald accent color to stand out but fit the aesthetic.
DO NOT use generic centered generic layouts. Use asymmetrical grids.
Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the soft cream text passes APCA contrast on espresso/plum backgrounds. Emerald accent text needs testing if on dark.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap Framer Motion parallax/reveals to respect user preference.

universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react.
Do not center align app container text globally.
Use modern button styles relevant to the app style.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
